compute.title: Compute Targets
compute.refreshFailed: Refresh failed; showing the previously loaded configuration. {{error}}
compute.enrollDescription: Fill in connection and container runtime settings. After submitting, you can follow enrollment progress on the compute targets page.
compute.enrollSuccess: Compute target enrolled; the enrollment record has been kept.

hint.sifManifest: Enter an absolute path on the gateway host.
hint.dataRoot: Leave empty to use ~/.autonomics/compute/<target ID> automatically.
hint.dataAlias: Leave empty to use the login SSH alias. If you specify another alias, also fill in the storage root.
hint.worker: Leave empty to auto-select the install directory. If a path is given, that worker is verified.
hint.deploy: Defaults to the worker installed with the system. You can also specify an absolute path to an installer package on the gateway host.
hint.sshCommand: Leave empty to use the site configuration.
hint.sifManifestJson: Enter the path of the manifest mapping container images to SIF files.
hint.singularityExecutable: Absolute path on the compute nodes. Leave empty to use /usr/bin/singularity.
hint.scratchDir: ~/ refers to the remote user's home directory.

compute.mountRootSuffix: as the root directory, with read/write support
compute.editDescription: Update compute settings and data source mounts.
compute.deleteDescription: Deleting unmounts the data sources attached to this target; their mount paths become inaccessible. Historical run records are kept and remote files are not deleted.
compute.workerConfigHint: JSON is saved with the compute target. File paths refer to the remote execution host.
compute.mountNote: Changes create a new read-only mount path; existing paths are kept until the target is deleted.

path.remoteDagTasksRetained: Remote DAG tasks and retained artifacts directory
